## What was measured (PR #17484's dev, from each PR's own event log)

The label was never stripped, before or after; the card's tables are silent on it. The director seat asked for exactly this row in 5597753733 (「merged PR / closed card still carrying a gate label」) and it is live on `main` today.

## The gap

`check-half-states.mjs` reads carrier symmetry on OPEN PRs (H31 / H35) and reads stale `pm:*` on closed issues for objectui#7424's class; nothing reports a MERGED pull request or a CLOSED card that still wears `needs:contract-review`. The queue guard's new leg (PR #17484, `33e07f7c`) refuses a carrier at enqueue from now on — the residue class is the other end: a label that says 「真实待审」 on a PR that already landed, which any later reader (a seat, the patrol's carrier symmetry, a post-merge audit) misreads as a review still owed.

## Shape (⛔ not prescribed — the lane decides)

A report-only H row: merged PRs (and closed cards) carrying `needs:contract-review`, with the merge time and the head, so the post-merge tier audit the director seat runs has a list rather than a memory; self-test both directions. Serial on the `check-half-states.mjs` chain.

## Dedup
